title: Diversity and Language Technology: How Techno-Linguistic Bias Can Cause Epistemic Injustice
reasoning: The paper is an ethical evaluation of language technology through the lens of social epistemology. It specifically utilizes the framework of 'epistemic injustice' and dedicates entire sections to 'Diversity as an Ethical Norm' and 'Ethical Concerns with Biases in Language Technology,' analyzing the moral and epistemological implications of technology design.
